# Esquire

> Esquire is a leading men's lifestyle magazine covering fashion, culture, politics, entertainment, food, and smart commentary with both digital and print access.

Esquire.com serves as the digital hub for the iconic Esquire magazine, offering curated content across men's style, entertainment news, food and drinks, sports, politics, and lifestyle advice. The site features expert product recommendations, celebrity interviews, and premium membership options for exclusive digital and print access.

## Key Topics

- Men's Fashion
- Style & Grooming
- Celebrity & Entertainment News
- Product Reviews & Roundups
- Cocktails & Drinks
- Food & Recipes
- Politics & News
- Lifestyle & Health
- Premium Membership
- Digital & Print Access
- Accessories & Watches
- Gift Guides
- Sports Coverage
- Tech Gadgets
- Esquire Archive

## Core Platforms & Membership

- [Esquire Homepage](https://www.esquire.com): Esquire homepage featuring fashion, culture, politics, and lifestyle
- [Subscribe to Esquire Premium Membership](https://shop.esquire.com/esquire-premium-membership.html): Esquire membership subscription plans with premium digital access
- [Esquire Premium Membership Tier 2](https://shop.esquire.com/esquire-premium-membership-tier-2.html): Esquire premium membership subscription with digital and print access
- [Esquire Newsletter Signup](https://www.esquire.com/email/esquire-newsletter): Free Esquire newsletter signup for news, culture, and lifestyle content

- [Men's Style - Tips and Advice for Men's Fashion, Grooming & Style](https://www.esquire.com/style): Men's fashion, grooming tips, and style advice from Esquire editors
- [13 Best Belts for Men 2026, According to Our Style Experts](https://www.esquire.com/style/mens-accessories/g39439976/best-belts-for-men): Expert-approved guide to the best men's leather belts and accessories
- [5 Best Ceramic Watches of 2026, Including a New Omega Speedmaster](https://www.esquire.com/style/mens-accessories/g70784202/best-ceramic-watches-march-2026): Guide to best ceramic watches from Omega, Hublot, and luxury brands
- [15 Solid Early Menswear Deals From Amazon's Big Spring Sale 2026](https://www.esquire.com/style/mens-fashion/g70761590/amazon-big-spring-sale-menswear-deals-2026): Amazon spring sale menswear deals on denim, watches, and Lacoste

## Entertainment & Culture

- [Val Kilmer's AI Movie Role Is a Hollywood Warning Sign](https://www.esquire.com/entertainment/movies/a70784529/val-kilmer-ai-movie): Opinion piece on AI recreation of Val Kilmer's likeness in film

## Lifestyle, Food & Drinks

- [Lifestyle - Best Men's Health, Career, Gifts, and Relationship Advice](https://www.esquire.com/lifestyle): Lifestyle hub with health, career, relationships, and product reviews

- [Drink Recipes - Best Cocktails to Make](https://www.esquire.com/food-drink/drinks): Cocktail recipes and bartending guides featuring whiskey and craft spirits
